name: Mars
tagline: The red planet — home of the tallest volcano and the deepest canyon known.
history: Mars was once warmer and wetter: orbiters and rovers have mapped ancient river deltas, lake beds and mineral veins that only liquid water could form. Today it is a cold desert with a thin CO₂ atmosphere and planet-encircling dust storms. Viking 1 achieved the first successful landing in 1976; since then a fleet of orbiters plus the Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity and Perseverance rovers have driven its surface, and Perseverance is caching samples for a planned return. It is the most explored planet beyond Earth and the declared destination for the first crewed interplanetary missions.
